fun plan(pr: PullRequest) {
  val prMeta = readFile(path="/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json")
  val diff = readDiff(path="/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val taskContext = readFile(path="/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val repoContext = readFile(path=".repo_context/README.md")
  val repoIndex = readFile(path=".repo_context/index.md")
  val maintenance = readFile(path=".repo_context/maintenance.md")
  val generatedIndex = readFile(path=".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
  val principles = readFile(path=".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
  val mmDocs = readFile(path="_mm/socratic/**/*.adoc")
  val codebaseMap = readFile(path="_mm/legion-map/CODEBASE.md")
  val codesetContext = readFile(path="_mm/vibed-codeset context for cli/disk_report.py and cli/command.py")
  val sourceFiles = readFile(path="cli/command.py and setup.py")
  val analysis = analyze(prMeta=prMeta, diff=diff, taskContext=taskContext, repoContext=repoContext, repoIndex=repoIndex, maintenance=maintenance, generatedIndex=generatedIndex, principles=principles, mmDocs=mmDocs, codebaseMap=codebaseMap, codesetContext=codesetContext, sourceFiles=sourceFiles)
  val evidence = writeFile(path="/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content=analysis)
  val completion = safeOutputNoop(message="Mental-model compliance evidence written; no GitHub comment needed for preflight fanout leg.")
}
